visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera looks down from a high-angle perspective between two legs clad in dark brown trousers, focusing on a black-gloved hand dangling motionlessly. The ground is a grey brick-paved sidewalk with a circular manhole cover visible. White text overlays appear at the bottom center. (2) A second hand with light skin and manicured white nails reaches into the frame from the right side and firmly grasps the dangling gloved hand. The background remains the static textured sidewalk and manhole cover under artificial night lighting conditions. (3) The camera tilts upward rapidly to track a young woman with long dark hair, a white chunky knit scarf, and a beige trench coat. She is laughing with her mouth wide open and running away from the lens down a narrow urban street lined with multi-story buildings and soft streetlights. (4) The woman stops running and turns around to face the camera directly, her expression filled with joy and mirth. The cameraman’s gloved hand reappears in the lower foreground. They join hands and walk together, with blurred city lights and storefronts forming the background.
